1.english_reference: On that day did the king Ahasuerus give the house of Haman the Jews ’ enemy unto Esther the queen

traditions.WLC: בַּ יּ֣וֹם הַ ה֗וּא נָתַ֞ן הַ מֶּ֤לֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵרוֹשׁ֙ לְ אֶסְתֵּ֣ר הַ מַּלְכָּ֔ה אֶת בֵּ֥ית הָמָ֖ן צֹרֵ֣ר ה יהודיים
traditions.LXX: Καὶ ἐν αὐτῇ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ὁ βασιλεὺς Ἀρταξέρξης ἐδωρήσατο Ἐσθὴρ ὅσα ὑπῆρχεν Ἁμὰν τῷ διαβόλῳ
traditions.VUL: Die illo dedit rex Assuérus Esther regínæ domum Aman adversárii Iudæórum ,
traditions.KJV: On that day did the king Ahasuerus give the house of Haman the Jews ’ enemy unto Esther the queen .

1.english_reference: And Mordecai came before the king

traditions.WLC: וּ מָרְדֳּכַ֗י בָּ֚א לִ פְנֵ֣י הַ מֶּ֔לֶךְ
traditions.LXX: καὶ Μαρδοχαῖος προσεκλήθη ὑπὸ τοῦ βασιλέως
traditions.VUL: et Mardochǽus ingréssus est ante fáciem regis .
traditions.KJV: And Mordecai came before the king ;

1.english_reference: for Esther had told what he [ was ] unto her

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי הִגִּ֥ידָה אֶסְתֵּ֖ר מַ֥ה הוּא לָֽ הּ
traditions.LXX: ὑπέδειξεν γὰρ Ἐσθὴρ ὅτι ἐνοικείωται αὐτῇ .
traditions.VUL: Conféssa est enim ei Esther quod esset pátruus suus .
traditions.KJV: for Esther had told what he [ was ] unto her .

2.english_reference: And the king took off his ring , which he had taken from Haman , and gave it unto Mordecai

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּ֨סַר הַ מֶּ֜לֶךְ אֶת טַבַּעְתּ֗ וֹ אֲשֶׁ֤ר הֶֽעֱבִיר֙ מֵֽ הָמָ֔ן וַֽ יִּתְּנָ֖ הּ לְ מָרְדֳּכָ֑י
traditions.LXX: ἔλαβεν δὲ ὁ βασιλεὺς τὸν δακτύλιον ὃν ἀφείλατο Ἁμὰν καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτὸν Μαρδοχαίῳ
traditions.VUL: Tulítque rex ánnulum , quem ab Aman récipi iússerat , et trádidit Mardochǽo .
traditions.KJV: And the king took off his ring , which he had taken from Haman , and gave it unto Mordecai .

2.english_reference: And Esther set Mordecai over the house of Haman

traditions.WLC: וַ תָּ֧שֶׂם אֶסְתֵּ֛ר אֶֽת מָרְדֳּכַ֖י עַל בֵּ֥ית הָמָֽן
traditions.LXX: καὶ κατέστησεν Ἐσθὴρ Μαρδοχαῖον ἐπὶ πάντων τῶν Ἁμάν .
traditions.VUL: Esther autem constítuit Mardochǽum super domum suam .
traditions.KJV: And Esther set Mordecai over the house of Haman .

3.english_reference: And Esther spake yet again before the king , and fell down at his feet

traditions.WLC: וַ תּ֣וֹסֶף אֶסְתֵּ֗ר וַ תְּדַבֵּר֙ לִ פְנֵ֣י הַ מֶּ֔לֶךְ וַ תִּפֹּ֖ל לִ פְנֵ֣י רַגְלָ֑י
traditions.LXX: καὶ προσθεῖσα ἐλάλησεν πρὸς τὸν βασιλέα καὶ προσέπεσεν πρὸς τοὺς πόδας αὐτοῦ
traditions.VUL: Nec his conténta , prócidit ad pedes regis , flevítque , et locúta ad eum orávit ,
traditions.KJV: And Esther spake yet again before the king , and fell down at his feet ,

3.english_reference: and besought him with tears to put away the mischief of Haman the Agagite

traditions.WLC: ו וַ תֵּ֣בְךְּ וַ תִּתְחַנֶּן ל֗ וֹ לְ הַֽעֲבִיר֙ אֶת רָעַת֙ הָמָ֣ן הָֽ אֲגָגִ֔י
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἠξίου ἀφελεῖν τὴν Ἀμὰν κακίαν
traditions.VUL: ut malítiam Aman Agagítæ ,
traditions.KJV: and besought him with tears to put away the mischief of Haman the Agagite ,

3.english_reference: and his device that he had devised against the Jews

traditions.WLC: וְ אֵת֙ מַֽחֲשַׁבְתּ֔ וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר חָשַׁ֖ב עַל הַ יְּהוּדִֽים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ὅσα ἐποίησεν τοῖς Ἰουδαίοις .
traditions.VUL: et machinatiónes eius péssimas , quas excogitáverat contra Iudǽos , iubéret írritas fíeri .
traditions.KJV: and his device that he had devised against the Jews .

4.english_reference: Then the king held out the golden sceptre toward Esther

traditions.WLC: וַ יּ֤וֹשֶׁט הַ מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ לְ אֶסְתֵּ֔ר אֵ֖ת שַׁרְבִ֣ט הַ זָּהָ֑ב
traditions.LXX: ἐξέτεινεν δὲ ὁ βασιλεὺς Ἐσθὴρ τὴν ῥάβδον τὴν χρυσῆν
traditions.VUL: At ille ex more sceptrum áureum proténdit manu , quo signum cleméntiæ monstrabátur :
traditions.KJV: Then the king held out the golden sceptre toward Esther .

4.english_reference: So Esther arose , and stood before the king

traditions.WLC: וַ תָּ֣קָם אֶסְתֵּ֔ר וַֽ תַּעֲמֹ֖ד לִ פְנֵ֥י הַ מֶּֽלֶךְ
traditions.LXX: ἐξηγέρθη δὲ Ἐσθὴρ παρεστηκέναι τῷ βασιλεῖ .
traditions.VUL: illáque consúrgens stetit ante eum ,
traditions.KJV: So Esther arose , and stood before the king ,

5.english_reference: And said , If it please the king , and if I have found favour in his sight , and the thing [ seem ] right before the king , and I [ be ] pleasing in his eyes

traditions.WLC: וַ֠ תֹּאמֶר אִם עַל הַ מֶּ֨לֶךְ ט֜וֹב וְ אִם מָצָ֧אתִי חֵ֣ן לְ פָנָ֗י ו וְ כָשֵׁ֤ר הַ דָּבָר֙ לִ פְנֵ֣י הַ מֶּ֔לֶךְ וְ טוֹבָ֥ה אֲנִ֖י בְּ עֵינָ֑י
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν Ἐσθήρ Εἰ δοκεῖ σοι καὶ εὗρον χάριν
traditions.VUL: et ait : Si placet regi , et si invéni grátiam in óculis eius , et deprecátio mea non ei vidétur esse contrária ,
traditions.KJV: And said , If it please the king , and if I have found favour in his sight , and the thing [ seem ] right before the king , and I [ be ] pleasing in his eyes ,

5.english_reference: let it be written to reverse the letters devised by Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite

traditions.WLC: ו יִכָּתֵ֞ב לְ הָשִׁ֣יב אֶת הַ סְּפָרִ֗ים מַחֲשֶׁ֜בֶת הָמָ֤ן בֶּֽן הַמְּדָ֨תָא֙ הָ אֲגָגִ֔י
traditions.LXX: πεμφθήτω ἀποστραφῆναι τὰ γράμματα τὰ ἀπεσταλμένα ὑπὸ Ἁμάν
traditions.VUL: óbsecro , ut novis epístolis , véteres Aman lítteræ , insidiatóris et hostis Iudæórum ,
traditions.KJV: let it be written to reverse the letters devised by Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite ,

5.english_reference: which he wrote to destroy the Jews which [ are ] in all the king ’s provinces

traditions.WLC: אֲשֶׁ֣ר כָּתַ֗ב לְ אַבֵּד֙ אֶת הַ יְּהוּדִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּ כָל מְדִינ֥וֹת הַ מֶּֽלֶךְ
traditions.LXX: τὰ γραφέντα ἀπολέσθαι τοὺς Ἰουδαίους οἵ εἰσιν ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ σου .
traditions.VUL: quibus eos in cunctis regis provínciis períre præcéperat , corrigántur .
traditions.KJV: which he wrote to destroy the Jews which [ are ] in all the king ’s provinces :

6.english_reference: For how can I endure to see the evil that shall come unto my people ?

traditions.WLC: כִּ֠י אֵיכָכָ֤ה אוּכַל֙ וְֽ רָאִ֔יתִי בָּ רָעָ֖ה אֲשֶׁר יִמְצָ֣א אֶת עַמִּ֑ י
traditions.LXX: πῶς γὰρ δυνήσομαι ἰδεῖν τὴν κάκωσιν τοῦ λαοῦ μου
traditions.VUL: Quómodo enim pótero sustinére necem et interfectiónem pópuli mei ?
traditions.KJV: For how can I endure to see the evil that shall come unto my people ?

6.english_reference: or how can I endure to see the destruction of my kindred ?

traditions.WLC: וְ אֵֽיכָכָ֤ה אוּכַל֙ וְֽ רָאִ֔יתִי בְּ אָבְדַ֖ן מוֹלַדְתִּֽ י
traditions.LXX: καὶ πῶς δυνήσομαι σωθῆναι ἐν τῇ ἀπωλείᾳ τῆς πατρίδος μου .
traditions.KJV: or how can I endure to see the destruction of my kindred ?

7.english_reference: Then the king Ahasuerus said unto Esther the queen and to Mordecai the Jew

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֨אמֶר הַ מֶּ֤לֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵרֹשׁ֙ לְ אֶסְתֵּ֣ר הַ מַּלְכָּ֔ה וּֽ לְ מָרְדֳּכַ֖י הַ יְּהוּדִ֑י
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ βασιλεὺς πρὸς Ἐσθήρ
traditions.VUL: Respondítque rex Assuérus Esther regínæ , et Mardochǽo Iudǽo :
traditions.KJV: Then the king Ahasuerus said unto Esther the queen and to Mordecai the Jew ,

7.english_reference: Behold , I have given Esther the house of Haman

traditions.WLC: הִנֵּ֨ה בֵית הָמָ֜ן נָתַ֣תִּי לְ אֶסְתֵּ֗ר
traditions.LXX: Εἰ πάντα τὰ ὑπάρχοντα Ἁμὰν ἔδωκα καὶ ἐχαρισάμην σοι
traditions.VUL: Domum Aman concéssi Esther ,
traditions.KJV: Behold , I have given Esther the house of Haman ,

7.english_reference: and him they have hanged upon the gallows , because he laid his hand upon the Jews

traditions.WLC: וְ אֹת וֹ֙ תָּל֣וּ עַל הָ עֵ֔ץ עַ֛ל אֲשֶׁר שָׁלַ֥ח יָד֖ וֹ ב יהודיים
traditions.LXX: καὶ αὐτὸν ἐκρέμασα ἐπὶ ξύλου ὅτι τὰς χεῖρας ἐπήνεγκε τοῖς Ἰουδαίοις τί ἔτι ἐπιζητεῖς .
traditions.VUL: et ipsum iussi affígi cruci , quia ausus est manum míttere in Iudǽos .
traditions.KJV: and him they have hanged upon the gallows , because he laid his hand upon the Jews .

8.english_reference: Write ye also for the Jews , as it liketh you , in the king ’s name , and seal [ it ] with the king ’s ring

traditions.WLC: וְ֠ אַתֶּם כִּתְב֨וּ עַל הַ יְּהוּדִ֜ים כַּ טּ֤וֹב בְּ עֵֽינֵי כֶם֙ בְּ שֵׁ֣ם הַ מֶּ֔לֶךְ וְ חִתְמ֖וּ בְּ טַבַּ֣עַת הַ מֶּ֑לֶךְ
traditions.LXX: γράψατε καὶ ὑμεῖς ἐκ τοῦ ὀνόματός μου ὡς δοκεῖ ὑμῖν καὶ σφραγίσατε τῷ δακτυλίῳ μου
traditions.VUL: Scríbite ergo Iudǽis , sicut vobis placet , regis nómine , signántes lítteras ánnulo meo .
traditions.KJV: Write ye also for the Jews , as it liketh you , in the king ’s name , and seal [ it ] with the king ’s ring :

8.english_reference: for the writing which is written in the king ’s name , and sealed with the king ’s ring , may no man reverse

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי כְתָ֞ב אֲשֶׁר נִכְתָּ֣ב בְּ שֵׁם הַ מֶּ֗לֶךְ וְ נַחְתּ֛וֹם בְּ טַבַּ֥עַת הַ מֶּ֖לֶךְ אֵ֥ין לְ הָשִֽׁיב
traditions.LXX: ὅσα γὰρ γράφεται τοῦ βασιλέως ἐπιτάξαντος καὶ σφραγισθῇ τῷ δακτυλίῳ μου οὐκ ἔστιν αὐτοῖς ἀντειπεῖν .
traditions.VUL: Hæc enim consuetúdo erat , ut epístolis , quæ ex regis nómine mittebántur , et illíus ánnulo signátæ erant , nemo audéret contradícere .
traditions.KJV: for the writing which is written in the king ’s name , and sealed with the king ’s ring , may no man reverse .

10.english_reference: And he wrote in the king Ahasuerus ’ name , and sealed [ it ] with the king ’s ring

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּכְתֹּ֗ב בְּ שֵׁם֙ הַ מֶּ֣לֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵרֹ֔שׁ וַ יַּחְתֹּ֖ם בְּ טַבַּ֣עַת הַ מֶּ֑לֶךְ
traditions.LXX: ἐγράφη δὲ διὰ τοῦ βασιλέως καὶ ἐσφραγίσθη τῷ δακτυλίῳ αὐτοῦ
traditions.VUL: Ipsǽque epístolæ , quæ regis nómine mittebántur , ánnulo ipsíus obsignátæ sunt ,
traditions.KJV: And he wrote in the king Ahasuerus ’ name , and sealed [ it ] with the king ’s ring ,

10.english_reference: and sent letters by posts on horseback , [ and ] riders on mules , camels , [ and ] young dromedaries

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּשְׁלַ֣ח סְפָרִ֡ים בְּ יַד֩ הָ רָצִ֨ים בַּ סּוּסִ֜ים רֹכְבֵ֤י הָ רֶ֨כֶשׁ֙ הָֽ אֲחַשְׁתְּרָנִ֔ים בְּנֵ֖י הָֽ רַמָּכִֽים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐξαπέστειλαν τὰ γράμματα διὰ βιβλιαφόρων .
traditions.VUL: et missæ per veredários : qui per omnes províncias discurréntes , véteres lítteras novis núntiis prævenírent .
traditions.KJV: and sent letters by posts on horseback , [ and ] riders on mules , camels , [ and ] young dromedaries :

11.english_reference: Wherein the king granted the Jews which [ were ] in every city to gather themselves together

traditions.WLC: אֲשֶׁר֩ נָתַ֨ן הַ מֶּ֜לֶךְ לַ יְּהוּדִ֣ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּ כָל עִיר וָ עִ֗יר לְ הִקָּהֵל֮
traditions.LXX: ὡς ἐπέταξεν αὐτοῖς χρῆσθαι τοῖς νόμοις αὐτῶν ἐν πάσῃ τῇ πόλει βοηθῆσαί τε αὑτοῖς
traditions.VUL: Quibus imperávit rex , ut convenírent Iudǽos per síngulas civitátes , et in unum præcíperent congregári
traditions.KJV: Wherein the king granted the Jews which [ were ] in every city to gather themselves together ,

11.english_reference: and to stand for their life

traditions.WLC: וְ לַ עֲמֹ֣ד עַל נַפְשָׁ ם֒
traditions.LXX: καὶ χρῆσθαι τοῖς ἀντιδίκοις αὐτῶν καὶ τοῖς ἀντικειμένοις αὐτῶν ὡς βούλονται .
traditions.VUL: ut starent pro animábus suis ,
traditions.KJV: and to stand for their life ,

11.english_reference: to destroy, to slay, and to cause to perish, all the power of the people and province that would assault them

traditions.WLC: לְ הַשְׁמִיד֩ וְ לַ הֲרֹ֨ג וּ לְ אַבֵּ֜ד אֶת כָּל חֵ֨יל עַ֧ם וּ מְדִינָ֛ה הַ צָּרִ֥ים אֹתָ֖ ם
traditions.VUL: et omnes inimícos suos
traditions.KJV: to destroy , to slay , and to cause to perish , all the power of the people and province that would assault them , [ both ]

traditions.WLC: טַ֣ף וְ נָשִׁ֑ים
traditions.VUL: cum coniúgibus ac líberis
traditions.KJV: little ones and women ,

11.english_reference: and [ to take ] the spoil of them for a prey

traditions.WLC: וּ שְׁלָלָ֖ ם לָ בֽוֹז
traditions.VUL: et univérsis dómibus , interfícerent atque delérent , et spólia eórum diríperent .
traditions.KJV: and [ to take ] the spoil of them for a prey ,

12.english_reference: Upon one day in all the provinces of king Ahasuerus

traditions.WLC: בְּ י֣וֹם אֶחָ֔ד בְּ כָל מְדִינ֖וֹת הַ מֶּ֣לֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵר֑וֹשׁ
traditions.VUL: Et constitúta est per omnes províncias una ultiónis dies ,
traditions.KJV: Upon one day in all the provinces of king Ahasuerus , [ namely ] ,

12.english_reference: [ namely ] , upon the thirteenth [ day ] of the twelfth month

traditions.WLC: בִּ שְׁלוֹשָׁ֥ה עָשָׂ֛ר לְ חֹ֥דֶשׁ שְׁנֵים עָשָׂ֖ר
traditions.VUL: id est tertiadécima mensis duodécimi
traditions.KJV: upon the thirteenth [ day ] of the twelfth month ,

traditions.WLC: הוּא חֹ֥דֶשׁ אֲדָֽר
traditions.VUL: Adar .
traditions.KJV: which [ is ] the month Adar .

13.english_reference: The copy of the writing for a commandment to be given in every province [ was ] published unto all people

traditions.WLC: פַּתְשֶׁ֣גֶן הַ כְּתָ֗ב לְ הִנָּ֤תֵֽן דָּת֙ בְּ כָל מְדִינָ֣ה וּ מְדִינָ֔ה גָּל֖וּי לְ כָל הָ עַמִּ֑ים
traditions.VUL: Summáque epístolæ hæc fuit , ut in ómnibus terris ac pópulis , qui regis Assuéri subiacébant império , notum fíeret ,
traditions.KJV: The copy of the writing for a commandment to be given in every province [ was ] published unto all people ,

13.english_reference: and that the Jews should be ready against that day to avenge themselves on their enemies

traditions.WLC: וְ לִ הְי֨וֹת ה יהודיים עתודים לַ יּ֣וֹם הַ זֶּ֔ה לְ הִנָּקֵ֖ם מֵ אֹיְבֵי הֶֽם
traditions.VUL: parátos esse Iudǽos ad capiéndam vindíctam de hóstibus suis .
traditions.KJV: and that the Jews should be ready against that day to avenge themselves on their enemies .

14.english_reference: [ So ] the posts that rode upon mules [ and ] camels went out

traditions.WLC: הָ רָצִ֞ים רֹכְבֵ֤י הָ רֶ֨כֶשׁ֙ הָֽ אֲחַשְׁתְּרָנִ֔ים יָֽצְא֛וּ
traditions.VUL: Egressíque sunt veredárii céleres núntia perferéntes ,
traditions.KJV: [ So ] the posts that rode upon mules [ and ] camels went out ,

14.english_reference: being hastened and pressed on by the king ’s commandment

traditions.WLC: מְבֹהָלִ֥ים וּ דְחוּפִ֖ים בִּ דְבַ֣ר הַ מֶּ֑לֶךְ
traditions.KJV: being hastened and pressed on by the king ’s commandment .

14.english_reference: And the decree was given at Shushan the palace

traditions.WLC: וְ הַ דָּ֥ת נִתְּנָ֖ה בְּ שׁוּשַׁ֥ן הַ בִּירָֽה
traditions.VUL: et edíctum regis pepéndit in Susan .
traditions.KJV: And the decree was given at Shushan the palace .

15.english_reference: And Mordecai went out from the presence of the king in royal apparel of blue and white

traditions.WLC: וּ מָרְדֳּכַ֞י יָצָ֣א מִ לִּ פְנֵ֣י הַ מֶּ֗לֶךְ בִּ לְב֤וּשׁ מַלְכוּת֙ תְּכֵ֣לֶת וָ ח֔וּר
traditions.VUL: Mardochǽus autem de palátio , et de conspéctu regis egrédiens , fulgébat véstibus régiis , hyacínthinis vidélicet et aériis ,
traditions.KJV: And Mordecai went out from the presence of the king in royal apparel of blue and white ,

15.english_reference: and with a great crown of gold

traditions.WLC: וַ עֲטֶ֤רֶת זָהָב֙ גְּדוֹלָ֔ה
traditions.VUL: corónam áuream portans in cápite ,
traditions.KJV: and with a great crown of gold ,

15.english_reference: and with a garment of fine linen and purple

traditions.WLC: וְ תַכְרִ֥יךְ בּ֖וּץ וְ אַרְגָּמָ֑ן
traditions.VUL: et amíctus sérico pállio atque purpúreo .
traditions.KJV: and with a garment of fine linen and purple :

15.english_reference: and the city of Shushan rejoiced and was glad

traditions.WLC: וְ הָ עִ֣יר שׁוּשָׁ֔ן צָהֲלָ֖ה וְ שָׂמֵֽחָה
traditions.VUL: Omnísque cívitas exsultávit , atque lætáta est .
traditions.KJV: and the city of Shushan rejoiced and was glad .

16.english_reference: The Jews had light , and gladness , and joy , and honour

traditions.WLC: לַ יְּהוּדִ֕ים הָֽיְתָ֥ה אוֹרָ֖ה וְ שִׂמְחָ֑ה וְ שָׂשֹׂ֖ן וִ יקָֽר
traditions.VUL: Iudǽis autem nova lux oríri visa est , gáudium , honor , et tripúdium .
traditions.KJV: The Jews had light , and gladness , and joy , and honour .

17.english_reference: And in every province , and in every city , whithersoever the king ’s commandment and his decree came

traditions.WLC: וּ בְ כָל מְדִינָ֨ה וּ מְדִינָ֜ה וּ בְ כָל עִ֣יר וָ עִ֗יר מְקוֹם֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר דְּבַר הַ מֶּ֤לֶךְ וְ דָת וֹ֙ מַגִּ֔יעַ
traditions.VUL: Apud omnes pópulos , urbes , atque províncias , quocúmque regis iussa veniébant ,
traditions.KJV: And in every province , and in every city , whithersoever the king ’s commandment and his decree came ,

17.english_reference: the Jews had joy and gladness , a feast and a good day

traditions.WLC: שִׂמְחָ֤ה וְ שָׂשׂוֹן֙ לַ יְּהוּדִ֔ים מִשְׁתֶּ֖ה וְ י֣וֹם ט֑וֹב
traditions.VUL: mira exsultátio , épulæ atque convívia , et festus dies :
traditions.KJV: the Jews had joy and gladness , a feast and a good day .

17.english_reference: And many of the people of the land became Jews

traditions.WLC: וְ רַבִּ֞ים מֵֽ עַמֵּ֤י הָ אָ֨רֶץ֙ מִֽתְיַהֲדִ֔ים
traditions.VUL: in tantum ut plures altérius gentis et sectæ eórum religióni et cæremóniis iungeréntur .
traditions.KJV: And many of the people of the land became Jews ;

17.english_reference: for the fear of the Jews fell upon them

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי נָפַ֥ל פַּֽחַד הַ יְּהוּדִ֖ים עֲלֵי הֶֽם
traditions.VUL: Grandis enim cunctos Iudáici nóminis terror inváserat .
traditions.KJV: for the fear of the Jews fell upon them .
